title: Candidate {{id}}
anonymous: Until an invitation is accepted or the candidate applies, the profile is anonymous: no name, photo, age, university or contacts.

skills.title: Skill profile
skills.lead: Level and margin of error for each topic. Badges show what confirms the level.
skills.empty: The profile appears after the test

fsp.title: FSP achievements
fsp.lead: The strongest signal in the profile. It does not change the grade or category.
fsp.empty: The candidate has not linked an FSP ID. There is no penalty: the profile is built from the test.

self.title: Self-reported
self.lead: Self-reported data does not affect the category or level; the stack adds to the fit up to a cap.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.lead: Visible because the candidate accepted an invitation or applied.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.lead: Contacts open once the candidate accepts the invitation.
